methodology.corpus: fresh deterministic six-deck H17 simulation shoes
methodology.round_pairing: card allocation may diverge after policies choose different actions
methodology.shoe_pairing: same replay order and cut-card position
methodology.transformer_context_overflow: remove only the minimum oldest visible-history card tokens needed to fit 256; preserve the complete current decision
methodology.variance_pooling: per-shoe sample means and variances pooled with both within- and between-report sums of squares

primary_result.metric: paired transformer-minus-Hi-Lo log-bankroll growth per shoe

transformer_context_statistics.interpretation: uninstrumented reports used the former fail-on-overflow behavior, so they completed without any overlength decision
